The seasonal strip follows an emergent stand through the wet-season flush, main fruiting pulse, dry-season peak and warm rainy season. Each tile records all 65 rainforest requirements, the three canopy strata, water, hazards, land use, goods and fauna. Not a GPU performance benchmark.
